name: Anna Strolenberg - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text:
**What this report asks for**

This report is the European Parliament's opinion, not a new law. It calls on the European Union and its member states to do more to protect people's basic rights. It asks for stronger action against corruption, better protection for journalists, and rules on spyware. It wants fairer treatment of migrants at borders, more protection for women and LGBTIQ people, and support for civil society groups. It also asks for action against poverty and discrimination.

**Key points**

- It asks for new rules and funding; nothing changes in law yet.
- It affects journalists, migrants, women, LGBTIQ people, minorities and civil society groups.
- The European Commission and member states are asked to act; Parliament votes on the text.
